messages:
Priya (PM): Quick question: how should filter affordances behave in the new slim sidecar? Specifically: saved queries, visibility, and quota implications.
Luis (Backend): Short answer: sidecar = lightweight preview. Filters should be apply-only (client-side state) unless user explicitly chooses "Save as query".
Zoe (Design): Agreed. We want minimal noise. Show applied filters in a compact pill row, and a subtle "Save" CTA that opens the full save modal.
Kiran (Platform): From quotas: previews must be sampled (default 0.5-1%). Any "Save" action transitions to persistent savedQuery which inherits the user's sample/route quota.
Priya (PM): For savedQuery metadata we need scope + visibility. Proposal: scope: [route_id, model_id, mode: sidecar|full], visibility: private|team|org.
Luis (Backend): API sketch:
```json
{
  "name": "errors-on-llm",
  "filters": [{"field":"status","op":"eq","value":500}],
  "scope": {"type":"sidecar","route":"r_88","model":"m_small"},
  "visibility": "team"
}
```
Priya (PM): Important: when creating a savedQuery from sidecar, default to private to avoid accidental team-wide quota hits. User can change to team/org in modal.
Zoe (Design): Modal should show estimated cost delta when changing visibility or sample rate. Tiny inline microcopy: "Making this available to your team can increase query costs".
Omar (SRE): Implementation detail: include header `X-Console-Preview: sidecar` for preview calls so we can route to a separate rate-limit bucket. Also add `X-Console-Sample: 0.01` when sampled client-side.
Kiran (Platform): We'll support `rate_limit_group: console-sidecar-preview` and a soft quota response: 200 with partial payload + header `X-Console-Partial: true`. Console shows a subtle warning then. Avoid 429 in UI for better UX.
metrics-bot: metric event: dashboard.preview.requests incremented by 1 (route=r_88, model=m_small, sample=0.01)
Luis (Backend): Edge case: model compare inside sidecar. If user toggles "compare models" we should prompt confirmation: "This will switch to full sampling for your session". Triggering compare should call endpoint with sample=1 for that user session.
Priya (PM): Rollout plan suggestion: internal QA -> 5 beta tenants -> 20% of sessions -> all. Gate with feature-flag `console.sidecar.filters` and monitor: preview-error-rate, partial-response-rate, save-conversion-rate, team-save-rate.
Zoe (Design): Two experiments: A) Save CTA inline on pill row, B) Save CTA in collapsed menu. Measure conversion and accidental saves.
Kiran (Platform): Telemetry contract: emit events `console.sidecar.preview`, `console.sidecar.save_attempt`, `console.sidecar.save_complete`. Include {user_id,route_id,model_id,sample_rate,visibility_before,visibility_after}.
Omar (SRE): Also log audit when a savedQuery with visibility != private is created. We must capture actor and ip.
Luis (Backend): Backwards compat: existing savedQuery without scope -> treat as full route view. New clients should set scope.type. Server will accept missing fields for older UIs.
Priya (PM): UX for quota exhaustion: show a CTA in sidecar: "Preview limit reached for this route. Request preview quota" linking to support flow. If soft-partial responses are returned, show a faded banner: "partial data (sampling applied)".
Zoe (Design): Small UI detail: sampled badge + tooltip "sampled at 1% for previews. Save to persist higher sampling". Show cost preview when toggling visibility.
Luis (Backend): Quick auth note: saving a query should validate route ACLs and the target visibility scope. If user lacks team-write, block option.
Kiran (Platform): We'll add a short-circuit: if tenant-managed quotas (Dedicated/Private), honor tenant policy and surface a console warning if tenant blocks previews.
metrics-bot: metric event: dashboard.saved_queries.created (user=U_12,scope=sidecar,visibility=private)
Priya (PM): Action items: Luis -> PR for API + header handling. Kiran -> add rate_limit_group + soft-partial behavior. Zoe -> design mocks + modal copy. Omar -> audit/logging requirements. I'll own rollout plan and feature flag.
Luis (Backend): One more Q: Do saved queries created from sidecar get auto-placed in a special folder?
Zoe (Design): Yes: default folder = "Sidecar Drafts" (private). Users can move to team folders later. Minimizes clutter.
Priya (PM): Sounds good. Anyone object to default private + Sidecar Drafts?
Kiran (Platform): No objections. :thumbsup:
Omar (SRE): :thumbsup:
Zoe (Design): :thumbsup: :sparkles:
metrics-bot: scheduled report: sidecar_preview_counts daily at 06:00 UTC
Priya (PM): Thanks all — I'll create the tracked checklist and ping infra for the feature flag rollout window.
